mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals economic weakness and recession risk, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) and low housing starts (HOUST < 1500.0) signals simultaneous labor market weakness and consumer demand contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% AND HOUST < 1500.0.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 250 indicates high inflation, triggering expected Federal Reserve tightening that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 250.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) from the previous month signals economic contraction, reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) from the previous month signals weakening consumer demand, reducing retail sector confidence and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines from the previous month.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 8.0%) combined with a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals aggressive monetary policy response to economic weakness, stimulating equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0% AND FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) from the previous month signals deteriorating consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue visibility and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS declines from the previous month.
